data.long_meaning: The name Jerrold is of Germanic origin, derived from the Old High German words 'ger' meaning 'spear' and 'wald' meaning 'rule' or 'power'. The name Jerrold has been traditionally used as a masculine given name and is thought to mean 'wealth power' or 'spear rule'. The name Jerrold carries the meaning “Germanic: Wealth Power” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jerrold usually hope their child will grow to embody germanic: wealth power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
